en.html:
Ichizo Sorimachi. That was the man's name.

Wedged into this strange box, I looked up at his pale face. He was sitting on a rock, apparently thinking about something, with no expression at all.

Not one look in my direction. Not one word.

　青白い風貌のその男を、奇妙な箱に押し込められた
格好から見上げる。

　岩の上に腰掛けて、男は表情なく物思う様子だった。
　こちらには視線も、言葉も投げない。

en.html: The damage had not been fatal. Returning to my proper spider form straightaway had probably helped. Recovery was going quickly; by now I was already halfway there. Only, while I was out of action he had tied me up, and I still could not move. So perhaps 'fatal' was not entirely out of the question. If he decided to destroy me, bas. That would be that. But what did he want? I owed this man no conversation. Stubbornly, I had kept quiet. But if he also sat there with his mouth shut, how was I to learn anything? Very nice. He kidnaps me, I refuse to speak, and between us we have arranged one extremely unsuccessful conversation. Perhaps next he would demand a ransom and I would have to guess the amount. Fine. I would have to speak first. I sent a steel-signal toward him—◆somehow this box was interfering with the signal, so I could not contact Kageaki. But the man was right here. At this distance it ought to reach him.
en.text:
The damage had not been fatal. Returning to my proper spider form straightaway had probably helped. Recovery was going quickly; by now I was already halfway there.

Only, while I was out of action he had tied me up, and I still could not move. So perhaps 'fatal' was not entirely out of the question. If he decided to destroy me, bas. That would be that.

But what did he want? I owed this man no conversation. Stubbornly, I had kept quiet. But if he also sat there with his mouth shut, how was I to learn anything? Very nice. He kidnaps me, I refuse to speak, and between us we have arranged one extremely unsuccessful conversation. Perhaps next he would demand a ransom and I would have to guess the amount.

Fine. I would have to speak first.

I sent a steel-signal toward him—◆somehow this box was interfering with the signal, so I could not contact Kageaki. But the man was right here. At this distance it ought to reach him.

ja.html: 損傷は、致命的なものとはならず済んだ。 　すぐ本来の蜘蛛形すがたに戻ったのが功を奏したのだろう、 再生が迅速に進み、今はもう半ば快復している。 　もっとも機能停止に陥っている間に拘束され、今も 動けないのだから、やはり致命的な状態と考えるべき なのかもしれない。 　男が破壊する気になれば、それまでだ。 　しかし……どういうつもりなのか。 　こちらから口を利いてやる義理はなく、意地のよう に黙っていたが。向こうも口を開かないのでは事情が まるで理解できない。 　仕方もなかった。 　男に向かって、金打声きんちょうじょうを送る――◆この箱が如何なる 仕組みでか信号を妨害するため、景明との連絡は取れ ないのだが、この至近距離なら届くだろう。
ja.text:
損傷は、致命的なものとはならず済んだ。
　すぐ本来の蜘蛛形すがたに戻ったのが功を奏したのだろう、
再生が迅速に進み、今はもう半ば快復している。

　もっとも機能停止に陥っている間に拘束され、今も
動けないのだから、やはり致命的な状態と考えるべき
なのかもしれない。
　男が破壊する気になれば、それまでだ。

　しかし……どういうつもりなのか。
　こちらから口を利いてやる義理はなく、意地のよう
に黙っていたが。向こうも口を開かないのでは事情が
まるで理解できない。

　仕方もなかった。
　男に向かって、金打声きんちょうじょうを送る――◆この箱が如何なる
仕組みでか信号を妨害するため、景明との連絡は取れ
ないのだが、この至近距離なら届くだろう。

Muramasa《You know nothing. He has suffered enough already... even now he's suffering.》
Muramasa《If you want an answer for the sins carried by the name Muramasa, ask me. Don't touch Mido...》
Muramasa《I want to... let him be free now...》
Sorimachi"...As you say, I don't know all the details of what you and that fellow have been doing..."
Sorimachi"Mujhe kya? Why should I? For me there is only one important thing."
Muramasa《What...?》
Sorimachi"Whatever has happened, at the bottom of it that fellow hasn't changed. Not one little bit."
Sorimachi"Exactly as he was that time..."
Muramasa《...That time...?》
Sorimachi"You saw it too, didi. On that mountain, when he killed the Emishi children—"
Sorimachi"That bastard... he was crying."
Muramasa《—》
Sorimachi"That, you see..."
Sorimachi"That... somehow I just cannot..."
Muramasa《...You...》
Sorimachi"Heh, heh. Now, then."

　そうでしょう」村正《――――》雪車町「ねェ？」
